svg.text: Dev board: port 1 angle line only (underside)
Bottom view (column a at the top). Only these nets are drawn; everything else is left out.
ANG1: RJ12 pin 4 lead -> 1 kOhm resistor (lead side)
ADC0: 1 kOhm resistor (ESP side) -> ESP GPIO0, + the 100 nF filter cap
Underneath: rail ; bridges c9-c10, c10-c11, c11-b11, b14-b15
Solid = bare rail / bridge; numbered dots = part pins and leads soldered in from the top. Every dot of one color must beep to every other dot of that color, and never to the other color.
